response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced full-stack/systems engineer with strong software craftsmanship credentials, but his background shows no direct experience with experimentation platforms, feature flagging, telemetry systems, A/B testing, or growth engineering. His career has spanned many small-to-mid companies and diverse tech stacks (web, mobile, embedded, DLang) rather than the large-scale, high-availability, multi-team platform work this Principal/IC6 role demands, and there is no evidence of cross-team technical leadership at the scale required.
strengths: 15+ years of broad, hands-on engineering experience across web, mobile, embedded, and backend systems
Demonstrated low-latency, high-throughput systems experience (Dunnhumby/Sociomantic handling millions of requests/sec)
Strong track record of teaching, mentoring, and community building (workshops, talks, open-source projects)
concerns: No demonstrated experience with experimentation frameworks, feature flagging, A/B testing, or rollout-risk management
Career trajectory shows lateral moves across small companies/startups rather than progression into principal-level, multi-team technical leadership
No evidence of telemetry/metrics platform ownership or data science partnership at the scale this role requires

key_factors.factor: No evidence of Principal-level cross-team technical leadership or large-scale distributed systems ownership
Strong general engineering fundamentals and adaptability across stacks
